eventsFunctionsExtensions.name: Gamepads
eventsFunctionsExtensions.shortDescription: Gamepad/controller support: buttons, sticks, triggers, vibration. Mapper behaviors for 2D/3D.
description: Add support for gamepads (or other physical controllers).

- automatic "gamepad mapper" behaviors for 2D and 3D movement behaviors (platformer characters, top-down movement, 3D character etc...). Add one of these to the object with the movement behavior (i.e: the player most of the time) and the behavior will then be controlled automatically by the gamepad (it works by reading the gamepad state and simulating controls). No need for additional events to make it work once the behaviors are set up.
The Bomberman-like example handles 4 players with gamepads ([open the project online](https://editor.gdevelop.io/?project=example://goose-bomberman)).

eventsFunctionsExtensions.name: LevelSelector
eventsFunctionsExtensions.shortDescription: Numbered levels on pages, with locked levels and stars, to let the player choose a level.
description: A level selector shows numbered levels on one or more pages. The levels after the unlocked ones are locked, and the unlocked levels can show the stars won (from 0 to 3).
- Set the number of levels, the unlocked levels, the columns and the rows of a page in the properties.
- Use the condition "Any level is chosen" and the expression "Chosen level" to go to the scene of the level.
- When a level is completed, change the unlocked levels and the stars of the level (saved, for example, in the storage).
- The levels can be ordered in rows, or like a path on a map, with dots between them.
- It works with the mouse, touchscreens, keyboards (arrows, WASD, Enter) and gamepads.
Ready-to-use level selectors in many styles are in the asset store [level selectors pack](https://editor.gdevelop.io/?initial-dialog=asset-store&asset-pack=level-selectors-level-selectors).

The levels are laid out in the box of the preview of the variant, which keeps its margins when the selector is resized.
With a single level in a row (or a column) of the preview, the levels are spread with the same margin on both sides.
Lay out the levels at the first frame (once the selector has its size) and when it is resized.
A level chosen during a frame is kept until the next one, so that it can be checked in the events of the scene.
